dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Worried that your valuable goods will be robbed by bandits on the road? Worried about being waylaid by wild beasts while traveling alone in the mountains and forests?

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency: Delivering all goods safe and sound, and delivering you peace of mind!

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Note: Any and all consequences that arise due to a failure to honestly disclose the contents of cargo will be borne in their entirety by the customer.
